traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Redirect Attack
reactions.description: Trigger: a creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. The goblin chooses an adjacent Small or Medium ally, who becomes the target instead.

actions.name: Hex Stick
actions.note: Multiattack: two Hex Stick attacks; can replace one with Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Jinx
reactions.description: Trigger: a creature the goblin can see hits it with an attack roll. Response — Wisdom Saving Throw (DC 13) for the triggering creature: on a failure, the attack misses instead.
